text:
Priya K.: Quick thought — customers keep asking for faster way to get per-route insights with the filters they use daily. Right now they rebuild the same filters repeatedly. Can we discuss a lightweight "presets" UX that lives on the route/model inspector?
Jordan M.: +1. Do we want presets to be route-scoped, model-scoped, or org-wide? All three feels heavy.
Lee S.: I'd vote for route-scoped by default, with an option to "promote" to org-wide. Simpler permission model.
Sam W.: Route-scoped + shareable link sounds good. Curious how this ties into telemetry: saved presets should be instrumented so we know which ones are used.
Priya K.: Yes — want metrics: uses/day, avg query time when using preset, and whether preset reduced token spend (estimate).
Anika R.: UX idea: show small pill badges on the route list for active presets, and a quick dropdown to apply one. "Pin" for quick access.
Jordan M.: Implementation note: backend data model could be minimal: {"name", "filters", "scope", "owner", "metadata"}. Example:  ```json
{"name":"Errors > 5%","filters":[{"field":"status_code","op":">","value":500},{"field":"p50_latency","op":">","value":200}],"scope":"route","owner":"priya"}```
Lee S.: For security: route-scoped presets should inherit route read perms. Org-wide promotions need a separate ACL.
Sam W.: From storage/telemetry side: store presets as lightweight objects and index by route+owner. Track telemetry events: `preset_applied`, `preset_created`, `preset_promoted`.
Anika R.: How should saved presets interact with existing saved queries in analytics? We have "saved queries" today but it's clunky. Presets should be smaller, task-focused (e.g., "cost check", "SLO breach scan").
Priya K.: Exactly. Not full saved queries — think "view presets" for console-level quick checks, and full saved queries for analytics explorer. Different surfaces.
Jordan M.: Dev question: do we allow chaining (apply preset then further ad-hoc filters)? Data model should allow a base preset + ephemeral deltas.
Lee S.: Yes, support ephemeral overrides. When applying, UI should show a small toast: "Preset applied — edits won't change the saved preset unless you click Save".
Sam W.: Routing policy tie-in: some presets might prefer lower-cost model variants; we could add optional hint metadata like `preferred_model_family: gpt-medium` but it should be advisory only.
Priya K.: Nice. Also add a toggle on presets for whether they include model filters or only route-level telemetry fields.
Anika R.: Mockup posted: https://figma.com/file/abc123/presets — shows dropdown, pin states, promote flow.
Jordan M.: Need acceptance criteria: 1) Create/persist route-scoped presets, 2) Apply with ephemeral edits, 3) Promote to org if owner has perms, 4) Telemetry events and basic usage dashboard.
Lee S.: Backend tasks: schema migration (tiny), index by route_id, add ACL checks. Frontend: dropdown + small modal for create/edit + promote flow.
Sam W.: I'll add events to telemetry schema. Suggest event payload: `{"preset_id","route_id","user_id","action","latency_snapshot","token_estimate"}`.
Priya K.: Nice. Timeline? Want a small beta in console for a handful of customers next sprint.
Jordan M.: We can do a minimal MVP in 2 sprints: route-scoped create/apply/pin + telemetry. Promote & org-wide next.
console-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature/route-presets -> staging at 2026-04-06T03:00:00Z :rocket:
Anika R.: I'll draft copy for help center + short in-console tooltip.
Priya K.: Great — thanks everyone. I'll open a product ticket with the ACs and attach the figma.
